chunks: He said: Abu Nasr Muhammad ibn al-Husayn al-Muqri reported to me, from Abu Abdillah al-Husayn ibn Ali al-Razi, from Ja'far ibn Muhammad al-Hanafi, from Yahya ibn Hashim al-Simsar, from Amru ibn Shimr, from Hammad, from Abu al-Zubayr, from Jabir ibn Abdullah ibn Harram al-Ansari, who said:

I came to the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, and said: "O Messenger of Allah, who is your successor?" He withheld from me for ten days, not answering me. Then he said: "O Jabir, shall I not inform you about what you asked me?" I said: "May my father and mother be your ransom! By Allah, you were silent until I thought you were displeased with me."

He said: "I was not displeased with you, O Jabir, but I was waiting for what would come from the heavens. Then Jibreel, peace be upon him, came and said: O Muhammad, your Lord sends you salutations and says: Surely, Ali ibn Abi Talib is your executor and successor over your family and nation, the protector of your Pool, the bearer of your standard, preceding you into Paradise."

I said: "O Prophet of Allah, what about one who does not believe in this - shall I fight him?" He said: "Yes, O Jabir. This status was not established except to be followed. Whoever follows him will be with me tomorrow, and whoever opposes him will never arrive at the Pool."

key_terms.الذائد: Al-Dhaid - the protector who drives away, Ali's role as guardian of the Pool
key_terms.حوض: Hawdh - the Pool in the afterlife where the Prophet meets his followers
key_terms.خليفة: Khalifah - caliph, representative or successor in authority
key_terms.لِواء: Liwa - the standard or banner, symbolizing leadership
key_terms.وصيّ: Wasi - executor and successor appointed by divine command

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet Muhammad say about Ali ibn Abi Talib being his successor when Jabir asked him?
ai.summary: Jabir ibn Abdullah al-Ansari asked the Prophet Muhammad (SAWW) about his successor. After ten days of silence, the Prophet explained he was awaiting divine revelation. Jibreel then brought the message from Allah that Ali ibn Abi Talib is the Prophet's executor, successor over his family and nation, protector of the Pool (al-Hawdh), and bearer of his standard into Paradise. The Prophet affirmed that this appointment demands allegiance, and those who follow Ali will be with the Prophet on the Day of Judgement, while opponents will never reach the Pool.

en.mulla-asgharali-m-m-jaffer: 3. He said: Abu Nasr Muhammad ibn al-Husayn al-Muqri reported to me from Abu Abdillah al-Husayn ibn ‘Ali al-Razi, who reported from Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Hanafi, who reported from Yahya ibn Hashim al-Simsar, who reported from Amru ibn Shimr, who reported from Hammad, from Abu al-Zubair, from Jabir ibn Abdillah ibn Harram al-Ansari, who said:

Once I came to the Prophet, peace be upon him and his progeny, and asked: "O messenger of Allah, who is your successor?" He said that the Prophet kept silent for a while, not answering me. Then he said: "O Jabir, may I not answer your question?" So I said: "My father and my mother be your ransom; By Allah, you maintained a silence, till I thought you were not pleased."

He said: "O Jabir, I was not displeased with you. I was waiting for what the heavens would reveal, and then Jibraeel came to me saying: O Muhammad, your Lord sends you salutations and says unto you: Surely, ‘Ali ibn Abi Talib is your executor and your successor over your kinsfolk and the Ummah; and a protector of your Pool (al-Hawdh). He is the bearer of your standard, preceding you into Praradise."

I said: "O Prophet of Allah! Would you say that if someone did not believe in this, I should fight him?" He said: "Yes O Jabir. This status has not been established except for being followed. So whoever follows it, he will be with me tomorrow, (i.e. on the day of Judgement) and whoever opposes it, he will never arrive near me at the Pool (al-Hawdh)."
